## Walkthrough

Move dra-example-driver out of the main require list into hack/tools (v0.3.0); update Makefile to list the tool version from hack/tools, correct the Docker build arg, pin a tools blank-import, remove the old vendored module, and change tests to use a local driverName constant.

## Changes

**DRA example driver migration to hack/tools**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**Tool infrastructure for DRA v0.3.0** <br> `Makefile-deps.mk`, `hack/tools/go.mod`, `hack/tools/pinversion.go`, `hack/testing/e2e-common.sh`|Makefile `go list -m` runs from `$(TOOLS_DIR)`; `hack/tools/go.mod` adds `sigs.k8s.io/dra-example-driver v0.3.0` and multiple indirect version bumps; `hack/tools/pinversion.go` blank-imports the driver flags package; Docker build arg changed to `GO_VERSION`.|
|**Remove DRA from main module and vendor** <br> `go.mod`, `vendor/modules.txt`|Remove `sigs.k8s.io/dra-example-driver v0.2.1` from main `go.mod` and its vendored module stanza from `vendor/modules.txt`.|
|**Update e2e tests to use local driverName constant** <br> `test/e2e/dra/baseline/dra_test.go`, `test/e2e/multikueue/dra/dra_test.go`|Tests now define `driverName := "gpu.example.com"` locally and replace uses of `draconsts.DriverName` with this local constant across DeviceRequest and DeviceClass selector usages.|

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~25 minutes

## Poem

> 🐰 The driver hopped from main into tools tonight,
> Versions moved, build args set right,
> Tests tuck a name they now own,
> A little shuffle, a tidy home. 🥕
